seo_title: How to Prepare for Your Food Tour
seo_description: Prepare for your Simply Enak food tour in Malaysia. What to wear, what to bring, dietary notes, and what to expect.
hero_title: How to Prepare for Your Food Tour
hero_description: What to wear, what to bring, and what to expect — on both our join-in and private tours.

whatToWear.title: Wear proper shoes
whatToWear.description: You will be walking on wet market floors. They get slippery. Closed-toe is safest.

whatToWear.title: Cover up a bit
whatToWear.description: Malaysia is a modest country, especially around markets and temples. Shoulders and knees.

whatToWear.title: Light clothes
whatToWear.description: Hot and humid all year. Cotton or anything that breathes.

whatToWear.title: Rain jacket (Oct-Mar)
whatToWear.description: Afternoon storms are normal between October and March. Bring something packable.

whatToWear.title: Not white
whatToWear.description: You will spill food on yourself. Darker colours hide it better.

whatToBring.title: Water bottle
whatToBring.description: Refill it at the stops. Skip the plastic cups.

whatToBring.title: Cash
whatToBring.description: Most stalls do not take cards. Small notes are easier.

whatToBring.title: Phone or camera
whatToBring.description: Markets are crowded. Keep it close.

whatToBring.title: Small bag
whatToBring.description: So your hands are free for eating.

whatToExpect.title: Small groups
whatToExpect.description: Join-in tours cap at 7 people. Private tours are just your group.

whatToExpect.title: 3-4 hours of eating
whatToExpect.description: 6-8 stops. Do not eat breakfast before you come.

whatToExpect.title: 1-2 km of walking
whatToExpect.description: Slow pace. Lots of stops to eat and listen.

whatToExpect.title: Rain or shine
whatToExpect.description: We go in all weather. You will get wet.

whatToExpect.title: Guide orders for you
whatToExpect.description: No menus. Your guide picks the best dishes. Just say what you cannot eat.

dietary_intro: Let us know what you can and cannot eat when you book. We sort it out.
